primary_cta.subtext: Look around at your own pace, no enquiry needed
primary_cta.placement: Keep the <!-- CTA: primary --> marker at the end of 'Wearing and photographing a statement ring at a destination wedding', but move it below the 'If you are already picturing where the ring will make its first trip' sentence, so the 'where' question is raised first and the CTA block answers it. That sentence's own /destinations link is removed so the CTA block is the only primary link (no duplicate).

secondary_cta.subtext: One Wedded Advisor, and the fee agreed in writing before any work begins
secondary_cta.placement: Existing inline link in the last line of 'Where your ring goes next'. Wording is unchanged (the panel set this closing); only the URL's UTMs change from utm_medium=internal to the CTA format with utm_content=secondary. The subtext is already carried by the preceding panel-set sentence, so nothing is added.

lead_magnet.name: Wedded Wonderland digital magazine (free)
lead_magnet.placement: One quiet line after 'Some rings sit in two families...' at the end of 'What these 25 rings teach us: the styles at a glance', where the reader has finished the list and is still in browsing mode. Kept away from the primary CTA and the closing so the three asks do not crowd.

payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage dreaming, service_link /destinations, Wedded Concierge secondary, matching the services.md early-stage rule and the sister post engagement-ring-styles. Weighted enquiry likelihood is 1.6, so the primary is the low-pressure destinations hub, not an enquiry. The current marker sits above the 'first trip' sentence, so the CTA block would appear before the question it answers and directly beside a second /destinations link; moving the marker below the sentence and dropping the inline link fixes both. The panel's must_fix on the closing (vague hand-off, fee worry) is resolved in 08-final.md with brand-facts wording (one Wedded Advisor, venue, travel, vendors and payments, fee agreed in writing before any work begins); that closing is left as set, with only the UTM on its existing Concierge link brought into the CTA format. Deferred items (fee model, commission, deposits, named Advisor or phone line, scale) are not stated. No prices. /magazine exists (link-map, type magazine, topic lead magnet) and services.md lists it as the early-stage magnet. Suggested future magnet, not placed (exists: false on the site): a printable 'take this to your jeweller' ring style checklist built from the styles table. All targets confirmed in content-system/seo/link-map.csv (last_seen 2026-10-20); /wonderland-concierge is the brand-facts main commercial page.
